notes: Distance bands are read from the frozen low-flight frames: <110 m foreground, 250-500 m middle, >600 m captured-atlas band; walking-close is the <110 m LOD0 check.
Manual PNG review is required; this script does not judge appearance.

flight.method: Non-overlapping EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 passes; delayed availability polling
flight.gpuTotalMeaning: Sum of instrumented rendering passes from complete frames; excludes CPU work and presentation wait

walking.method: Non-overlapping EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 passes; delayed availability polling
walking.gpuTotalMeaning: Sum of instrumented rendering passes from complete frames; excludes CPU work and presentation wait

environment.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (0x00002B85) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
